paragraphs.text: AUV Plugin for DeepSeek Harness
# dsh-auv — AUV desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness
**English** | 简体中文

Adds AUV desktop automation to
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) as native model tools.

> [!WARNING]
> **Please install AUV before using this plugin.** On macOS, also grant **DeepSeek Harn

ess** the
> required permissions. See Before you start.
## Before you start
1. **Install the AUV command line tool and make sure it is on `PATH`.** Check with `auv --version`.
| Platform | Install |

| macOS | `brew install moeru-ai/tap/auv` |
| macOS / Linux | `curl -fsSL https://auv.moeru.ai/insta

ll.sh \| sh` |
| Windows | `scoop bucket add auv https://github.com/moeru-ai/auv` then `scoop instal

l auv/auv` |
| proto | `proto plugin add auv "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moeru-ai/auv/main/to
olchain/proto/auv.toml" --to global` then `proto install auv latest --config-mode global --pin globa
ain/proto/auv.toml" --to global` then `proto install auv latest --config-mode global --pin global` |

If AUV is not on `PATH`, set `AUV_BIN` to the full path of the `auv` executable before starting
Harn

ess. A running AUV daemon is enough for the plugin to connect, but starting one itself
needs the exe

unning AUV daemon is enough for the plugin to connect, but starting one itself
needs the executable.

2. **Install and enable this plugin** (see Install), then run `auv_doctor`. A ready
setup reports `a

and enable this plugin** (see Install), then run `auv_doctor`. A ready
setup reports `all_ok: true`.
## What is AUV
**AUV** means *Application Use Via ...*. Its authors describe it as programmable computer use — like
Playwright, but for the operating system.

- It is not an agent. It provides a command line tool, a local daemon, a stdio MCP server, typed
com

mand contracts and TypeScript/Rust SDKs. An agent or app calls it.
- Repeated GUI work becomes reusa

ble commands that record runs and artifacts, instead of a
screenshot → click → check loop. Once a fl

ow is a command, repeating it costs almost no model
tokens.
- macOS, Linux and Windows are supported

. AUV 0.0.43 has 43 core commands for displays, windows,
input, accessibility, media and scans.
Links:

- Repository: <https://github.com/moeru-ai/auv>
- Docs and install: <https://auv.moeru.ai>
- Terms a

nd concepts: <https://github.com/moeru-ai/auv/blob/main/docs/TERMS_AND_CONCEPTS.md>
- Supported apps
and extensions: <https://github.com/moeru-ai/auv/tree/main/supported>

## Install
The plugin is prebuilt.
Open **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin** and paste the latest release tarball:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Click install, then enable **AUV desktop automation**. The twelve `auv_*` tools show up on the next
model step. Run `auv_doctor` first.

The same input box also accepts an npm package name or a local directory. The repository does not
co

ntain the built bundle, so use the release tarball for normal installs. Development builds and
the r
elease process are documented in docs/implementation.md.
From a session you can use the command form with the same link:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Disable the plugin with
`plugin_manager action=set_plugin target=dsh-auv enabled=false`.
## macOS permissions
AUV controls the real desktop, so macOS must trust **DeepSeek Harness**, not just `auv`:

1. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**. On macOS 27 and later the permission lists are
und

er **Device Control and Data Access**; older versions show **Accessibility** and
**Screen Recording*

* separately.
2. Enable **DeepSeek Harness** there. If it is not listed, add
`/Applications/DeepSeek

Harness.app`, or trigger an input command once and allow the prompt.
3. Quit and reopen DeepSeek Ha

rness. Permission changes are only read when the process starts.
4. Run `auv_doctor`. `all_ok` shoul

d be `true`; the report shows which permission is missing
otherwise.

Screenshots and OCR need Screen Recording. Clicking, typing, key presses and scrolling need
Accessib

shots and OCR need Screen Recording. Clicking, typing, key presses and scrolling need
Accessibility.
## Tools
All twelve tools control AUV through the daemon connection described in Daemon lifecycle.
| Tool | What it does |
| `auv_doctor` | Reports permissions, daemon state and whether the setup is ready. Returns install a

nd permission guidance when something is missing; it does not throw. |
| `auv_screenshot` | Captures
the desktop, a window, an app, a display or a screen region. Returns a `.webp` file path for `read_

image`, plus capture bounds and pixel metadata. |
| `auv_ocr` | Finds text on screen or in a window.
With `wait: true` it polls until the text appears. Matches carry screen, window and image pixel poi

nts. |
| `auv_click` | Clicks text found by OCR, or an exact point. Optional button, target, click a

rea and coordinate space (`space: "screen"` is the reliable choice for Unity/Canvas apps). |
| `auv_

type` | Types or pastes text into the focused control. |
| `auv_keys` | Presses one key combination,

optionally repeated. `policy` and `focus` control delivery. |
| `auv_scroll` | Scrolls inside a win

dow, using window-local coordinates. |
| `auv_drag` | Drags the mouse from one point to another; scr

een, window or display coordinates, button, duration, and an optional focus-first step. |
| `auv_cap
ture_state` | Captures an in-memory snapshot of a window or region and returns a `state_token`; use

it before an action. |
| `auv_wait_for_change` | Watches a window or region and compares frames, ret
urning `changed`, `no_effect` or `timeout` with a `changed_ratio`. Pass a `state_token` from `auv_ca

pture_state` for the reliable check. |
| `auv_windows` | Lists windows with ids, app ids, titles, fr

ames and state. |
| `auv_activate` | Brings an application to the front. |

Screenshots are saved as `.webp` files. Call DSH's `read_image` tool with the returned path to
look
at one; the tool result never contains image bytes.
## Configuration
| Variable | Default | Effect |
| `AUV_BIN` | searched in `PATH`, then `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, `~/.local/bin`, `~/.ca
rgo/bin` | Full path to the `auv` executable. Needed only when the plugin has to start its own daemo

n. Invalid values fail with install instructions. |
| `AUV_DSH_SDK_STORE_ROOT` | `$DSH_HOME/auv/sdk`

(usually `~/.dsh/auv/sdk`) | Store directory for the daemon the plugin starts itself. |
